title: Amber Harness Tool (v1)
description: F067 (Harness v2 §12/§25/§30): one Tool declaration — Tool ≠ Capability ≠ Credential ≠ Permission. The capability is a REFERENCE resolved through the existing governed registries (F052 runner pin or F056 external-effect pin); the credential is a reference name and never material; the effect class comes from the closed §9 taxonomy with the default postures read_only=allow, local_write=scoped allow, command_execution=policy, external_read=policy, external_write=ask, credential_use=explicit grant, destructive=deny, irreversible=deny/human approval. Admitting a tool grants zero authority (connector ≠ permission); the runner/external gates stay the only enforcement.

capability.description: A reference into an EXISTING governed registry — never an executable definition. Runner pins resolve through the F052 runner registry (resolveRequestCapability); external pins through the F056 external-effect registry (showExternalEffect). An unresolvable pin refuses admission (drift-bound).

effect.description: Closed §9 taxonomy. Default postures (recorded, not enforced here): read_only=allow, local_write=scoped allow, command_execution=policy, external_read=policy, external_write=ask, credential_use=explicit grant, destructive=deny, irreversible=deny/human approval.

ref.description: Reference NAME only — no secret material ever enters the harness state area.
